iterations.theme: Zajednička molitva: molitva oslobođenja, posvete, Krunica i Litanije Božanskom milosrđu te Krunica otajstava svjetla

sections.subtitle: Radost neba zbog jednog obraćenog grešnika: molitveni susret otvara se zazivom zaštite
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Vladimir Grebenar pozdravlja gledatelje, najavljuje evanđelje dana i započinje molitvu oslobođenja
sections.content:
Novu epizodu medija **Ora et Labora** voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** otvara pozdravom „gledateljima i slušateljima“ i najavom evanđelja dana. Misao koja će obilježiti cijeli susret sažeta je u jednoj rečenici: **„Na nebu će biti radost zbog jednog obraćena grešnika.“** Odmah zatim, u ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga, Grebenar započinje zajedničku molitvu, i to molitvom oslobođenja od zlih sila.

U toj molitvi voditelj u ime Isusovo „uzima vlast“ i veže sve zle sile i snage. Nabraja svaki prostor u kojem one mogu djelovati:

- u zraku,
- na zemlji,
- u vodi,
- u podzemlju,
- na onome svijetu,
- u prirodi,
- i u vatri.

Isusa ispovijeda kao **Gospodina nad svim svemirom** i daje mu slavu u ime svega stvorenja. Zatim veže „sve demonske sile koje su došle protiv nas i naših obitelji“ i sve koji mole stavlja pod zaštitu Kristove dragocjene krvi, prolivene na križu.

Molitva se potom obraća Mariji. Grebenar traži njezinu zaštitu i zagovor kod Presvetog Srca Isusova za sve obitelji, uz molbu: **„Zaogrni nas svojim plaštem ljubavi, da se prestraši neprijatelj.“** U pomoć zaziva i svetog Mihovila te anđele čuvare da brane molitelje i njihove obitelji „u borbi protiv svega zla što obilazi svijetom“. U ime Isusovo zapovijeda silama zla da istog časa odstupe od molitelja, njihovih domova i njihove zemlje. Uvodni dio završava zahvalom Isusu, „jer si vjeran Bog i osjećaš s nama“.
sections.subtitle_en: Joy in heaven over one repentant sinner: prayer meeting opens with an invocation of protection
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Vladimir Grebenar greets viewers, announces the gospel of the day, and begins the prayer of deliverance
sections.content_en:
The host **Vladimir Grebenar** opens the new episode of the media **Ora et Labora** with a greeting to the "viewers and listeners" and an announcement of the gospel of the day. The thought that will mark the entire meeting is summarized in one sentence: **"There will be joy in heaven over one repentant sinner."** Immediately after, in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, Grebenar begins the common prayer, with a prayer of deliverance from evil forces.

In that prayer, the host in the name of Jesus "takes authority" and binds all evil forces and powers. He enumerates every space in which they can operate:

- in the air,
- on the earth,
- in the water,
- in the underworld,
- in the other world,
- in nature,
- and in fire.

He confesses Jesus as **Lord over the whole universe** and gives him glory in the name of all creation. Then he binds "all demonic forces that have come against us and our families" and places all who pray under the protection of Christ's precious blood, shed on the cross.

The prayer then turns to Mary. Grebenar asks for her protection and intercession with the Sacred Heart of Jesus for all families, with the petition: **"Clothe us with your mantle of love, so that the enemy may be terrified."** He also calls upon Saint Michael and the guardian angels for help to defend the intercessors and their families "in the fight against all evil that roams the world." In the name of Jesus, he commands the forces of evil to depart immediately from the intercessors, their homes, and their land. The introductory part concludes with thanks to Jesus, "for you are a faithful God and you empathize with us."

sections.subtitle: Vojvoda vojske nebeske i nježni zaziv „Moj ljupki Isuse“
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli molitvu svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu
sections.content:
Na molitvu oslobođenja Vladimir Grebenar nadovezuje tradicionalnu **molitvu svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu**. Arkanđela moli da brani vjernike „u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih“ i da im bude zaklon. Mihaela oslovljava kao **„vojvodu vojske nebeske“** i ponizno moli da „Sotonu i druge duhove zlobne, koji svijetom obilaze na propast duša“, božanskom krepošću i jakošću strovali u pakao.

Nakon odlučnih riječi borbe slijedi molitva drukčijeg tona, **„Moj ljupki Isuse“**. U njoj se moli za potpuno jedinstvo s Kristom i među samim moliteljima. Molitva u nizu slika nabraja što se želi ujediniti:

- da noge „zajedno hode“,
- da ruke budu „skupljene u jedinstvu“,
- da srca „kucaju zajedno“,
- da duše budu „u skladu“, a misli „kao jedno“,
- da uši „zajedno slušaju tišinu“,
- da pogledi „duboko prodru jedan u drugi“.

Molitva završava molbom da usne zajedno mole „da zadobijemo milosrđe od vječnoga Oca“. Time se već na početku najavljuje središnja tema epizode, Božje milosrđe.
sections.subtitle_en: Commander of the heavenly host and the tender invocation "My sweet Jesus"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar prays the prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel
sections.content_en:
Following the prayer of deliverance, Vladimir Grebenar continues with the traditional **prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel**. He asks the archangel to defend the faithful "in battle against the wickedness and snares of the devil" and to be their safeguard. He addresses Michael as the **"commander of the heavenly host"** and humbly prays that he, by the divine power and strength, cast into hell "Satan and all evil spirits who roam through the world for the ruin of souls."

After the resolute words of warfare follows a prayer of a different tone, **"My sweet Jesus"**. In it, a prayer is made for complete unity with Christ and among the intercessors themselves. The prayer enumerates in a series of images what is desired to be united:

- that feet "walk together",
- that hands be "gathered in unity",
- that hearts "beat together",
- that souls be "in harmony", and thoughts "as one",
- that ears "together listen to the silence",
- that glances "penetrate deeply into one another".

The prayer concludes with a petition that lips pray together "that we may obtain mercy from the eternal Father". Thereby, right at the beginning, the central theme of the episode, God's mercy, is announced.

sections.subtitle: Predanje cijelog bića: posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli molitvu posvete Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Sljedeći dio molitvenog susreta posvećen je **posveti**. Vladimir Grebenar Presvetu Djevicu Mariju oslovljava kao „majku i kraljicu“ te njezinu bezgrešnom srcu posvećuje i predaje „čitavo svoje biće, svoje misli, riječi i djela“. Molitva ide i dalje: moli Mariju da raspolaže molitateljem i svime što mu pripada, „sada i u vječnosti“. Sve to čini na hvalu i slavu Presvetoga Trojstva, za posvećenje Crkve i spasenje svega svijeta.

U posveti posebno mjesto ima **krsno posvećenje**. Voditelj moli Mariju da mu pomogne živjeti dostojno tog posvećenja, kako bi neopozivo pripadao svome Otkupitelju. Moli i da poput nje sluša poticaje Duha Svetoga, uz zaključni zaziv: **„Neka se u meni i u svemu vrši volja Božja.“**

Zatim slijedi molitva **Presvetom Srcu Isusovu**, koje se naziva „izvorom svakoga dobra“. Molitelj mu se klanja, vjeruje u njega, ufa se u njega, ljubi ga i kaje se za svoje grijehe. Isusu poklanja svoje „siromašno srce“ i moli da ga učini poniznim, strpljivim i čistim te da u svemu odgovara njegovim željama. Uz molbu „da ja živim u tebi i ti u meni“, nabraja se i niz konkretnih potreba:

- zaštita u opasnostima,
- utjeha u nevoljama i žalostima,
- zdravlje tijela,
- blagoslov za sav rad,
- milost svete smrti.
sections.subtitle_en: Surrender of the whole being: consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Sacred Heart of Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the prayer of consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
The next part of the prayer meeting is dedicated to **consecration**. Vladimir Grebenar addresses the Blessed Virgin Mary as "mother and queen" and consecrates and surrenders to her immaculate heart "his entire being, his thoughts, words, and deeds." The prayer goes further: it asks Mary to dispose of the person praying and everything that belongs to him, "now and in eternity." All this is done for the praise and glory of the Most Holy Trinity, for the sanctification of the Church, and the salvation of the whole world.

In the consecration, a special place is held by the **baptismal consecration**. The host asks Mary to help him live worthily of that consecration, so that he may belong irrevocably to his Redeemer. He also prays to listen, like her, to the promptings of the Holy Spirit, with the concluding invocation: **"May the will of God be done in me and in everything."**

Then follows the prayer to the **Sacred Heart of Jesus**, which is called the "fount of every good." The person praying adores it, believes in it, hopes in it, loves it, and repents of his sins. He presents Jesus with his "poor heart" and prays that he make it humble, patient, and pure, and that it conform in everything to his desires. Along with the petition "that I may live in you and you in me," a series of concrete needs is also enumerated:

- protection in dangers,
- comfort in afflictions and sorrows,
- health of the body,
- blessing for all work,
- the grace of a holy death.

sections.subtitle: Temelj kršćanske molitve: Oče naš, Zdravo Marijo i Vjerovanje
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar izgovara Apostolsko vjerovanje
sections.content:
Prije krunice Božanskom milosrđu Vladimir Grebenar moli tri temeljne molitve kršćanske tradicije. Prva je **Oče naš**, Gospodnja molitva koja moli da se sveti Božje ime, da dođe njegovo kraljevstvo i da se vrši njegova volja „kako na nebu tako i na zemlji“. U njoj se traži i svagdanji kruh, oproštenje dugova i izbavljenje od zla.

Slijedi **Zdravo Marijo**, pozdrav Djevici koja je „milosti puna“ i molba Majci Božjoj da moli za grešnike „sada i na času smrti naše“.

Treća je **Vjerovanje**, ispovijest vjere u Boga Oca svemogućega, stvoritelja neba i zemlje, i u Isusa Krista. Vjerovanje sažima Kristov put: začet je po Duhu Svetom, rođen od Marije Djevice, mučen pod Poncijem Pilatom, raspet, umro i pokopan, sašao nad pakao, treći dan uskrsnuo i uzašao na nebesa, odakle će doći suditi žive i mrtve. Ispovijest završava vjerom u Duha Svetoga, svetu Crkvu katoličku, općinstvo svetih, oproštenje grijeha, uskrsnuće tijela i život vječni.
sections.subtitle_en: The foundation of Christian prayer: Our Father, Hail Mary, and the Creed
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar recites the Apostles' Creed
sections.content_en:
Before the chaplet of Divine Mercy, Vladimir Grebenar prays three fundamental prayers of the Christian tradition. The first is the **Our Father**, the Lord's Prayer which prays that God's name be hallowed, that his kingdom come, and that his will be done "on earth as it is in heaven." In it, daily bread, forgiveness of debts, and deliverance from evil are also asked for.

Next is the **Hail Mary**, a greeting to the Virgin who is "full of grace" and a petition to the Mother of God to pray for sinners "now and at the hour of our death."

The third is the **Creed**, a profession of faith in God the Father almighty, creator of heaven and earth, and in Jesus Christ. The Creed summarizes Christ's journey: he was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried, descended into hell, on the third day rose again, and ascended into heaven, from where he will come to judge the living and the dead. The profession concludes with faith in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.

sections.subtitle: „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci“: krunica Božanskom milosrđu za cijeli svijet
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj započinje krunicu Božanskom milosrđu riječima „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv…“
sections.content:
Središnji dio prvog molitvenog bloka, u skladu s naslovom epizode, čini **krunica Božanskom milosrđu**. Vladimir Grebenar svaku od pet desetica otvara istom prikaznom molitvom: **„Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga Sina tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.“**

Nakon toga deset puta ponavlja zaziv koji nosi cijelu krunicu: **„Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.“**

U središtu ove molitve je Kristova muka, prikazana Ocu kao zadovoljština. Molitva ne ostaje ograničena na one koji mole, nego svaki zaziv obuhvaća „cijeli svijet“. Ritmično i mirno ponavljanje, desetica za deseticom, traje nekoliko minuta. Tako se gledatelji i slušatelji uvode u dugu, meditativnu molitvu, otvorenu prema milosrđu za sve ljude.
sections.subtitle_en: "For the sake of his sorrowful passion": chaplet of Divine Mercy for the whole world
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host begins the chaplet of Divine Mercy with the words "Eternal Father, I offer you the body and blood…"
sections.content_en:
The central part of the first prayer block, in accordance with the episode title, is the **chaplet of Divine Mercy**. Vladimir Grebenar opens each of the five decades with the same offering prayer: **"Eternal Father, we offer you the body and blood, soul and divinity of your dearly beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world."**

After that, he repeats ten times the invocation that carries the entire chaplet: **"For the sake of his sorrowful passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world."**

At the center of this prayer is Christ's passion, offered to the Father as atonement. The prayer does not remain limited to those who pray, but each invocation encompasses "the whole world." The rhythmic and calm repetition, decade after decade, lasts for several minutes. In this way, viewers and listeners are introduced into a long, meditative prayer, open toward mercy for all people.

sections.subtitle: Sveti Bože, krv i voda iz Srca Isusova i trostruko „Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli završne zazive krunice Božanskom milosrđu
sections.content:
Krunica Božanskom milosrđu završava trostrukim zazivom: **„Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože, smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu.“** Vladimir Grebenar ga izgovara tri puta, sabrano i polako.

Zatim slijedi zaziv koji milosrđe povezuje s ranjenim Kristovim Srcem: **„O krvi i vodo, što potekoste iz Srca Isusova kao izvor milosrđa za nas, uzdam se u tebe.“** Uz njega dolazi i kratka molba Mariji, kojoj se obraća kao **„majci milosrđa“**: „Moli za nas.“

Vrhunac ovog dijela je tri puta ponovljeno **„Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“**, zaziv pouzdanja koji je jezgra pobožnosti Božanskom milosrđu. Za njim slijedi još jedna molba za smilovanje „nama i cijelomu svijetu“.
sections.subtitle_en: Holy God, blood and water from the Heart of Jesus, and the triple "Jesus, I trust in you"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar prays the concluding invocations of the chaplet of Divine Mercy
sections.content_en:
The chaplet of Divine Mercy concludes with a triple invocation: **"Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world."** Vladimir Grebenar recites it three times, collectedly and slowly.

Then follows an invocation connecting mercy with the wounded Heart of Christ: **"O blood and water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fount of mercy for us, I trust in you."** Alongside it comes also a brief petition to Mary, who is addressed as **"mother of mercy"**: "Pray for us."

The peak of this part is the three times repeated **"Jesus, I trust in you"**, an invocation of trust that is the core of devotion to Divine Mercy. Following it is another petition for mercy "on us and on the whole world."

sections.subtitle: Litanije Božjem milosrđu: od stvaranja svijeta do utjehe umirućih
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli litanije, ponavljajući odgovor „uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Nakon krunice Vladimir Grebenar moli **Litanije Božjem milosrđu**. Počinju uobičajenim litanijskim zazivima „Gospodine, smiluj se“ i „Kriste, smiluj se“, nakon kojih se zaziva svaka božanska osoba: Oče nebeski, Sine, Otkupitelju svijeta, Duše Sveti i Sveto Trojstvo, jedan Bože.

Slijedi dugi niz zaziva u kojima se Božje milosrđe slavi pod mnogim vidovima. Na svaki se odgovara: **„uzdam se u tebe“**. Milosrđe Božje u litanijama je, među ostalim:

- „neshvatljiva tajna Presvetoga Trojstva“ i „izraz njegove najveće moći“,
- ono što se objavilo u stvaranju nebeskih duhova i što je ljude „iz ništavila pozvalo u život“,
- ono koje obuhvaća čitav svijet i daruje besmrtan život,
- ono koje štiti od zasluženih kazna i oslobađa od bijede grijeha,
- ono koje se izlijeva iz rana Kristovih i izvire iz Presvetog Srca,
- ono koje je ljudima dalo Presvetu Djevicu za majku milosrđa,
- ono vidljivo u ustanovljenju Crkve koja obuhvaća cijeli svijet i u dijeljenju svetih sakramenata,
- neograničeno u sakramentu krštenja i pokore te neizmjerno u sakramentu oltara i svećeništva,
- ono koje je ljude pozvalo k svetoj vjeri,
- prisutno u obraćenju grešnika, ono koje posvećuje pravednike i usavršava svete,
- vrelo bolesnicima i patnicima, utjeha onih „skršena srca“ i ufanje onih koji očajavaju,
- „mir umirućih“, zaštita od paklenoga ognja i olakšanje patnje dušama u čistilištu,
- slast i neizmjerna radost svih svetih te „neiscrpiv izvor čudesa“.

Osobito se ističe zaziv milosrđu „u obraćenju grešnika“, koji izravno odjekuje evanđeljem dana o radosti neba zbog jednog obraćenog grešnika.
sections.subtitle_en: Litany of the Divine Mercy: from the creation of the world to the consolation of the dying
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the litany, repeating the response "I trust in you"
sections.content_en:
After the chaplet, Vladimir Grebenar prays the **Litany of the Divine Mercy**. It begins with the usual litany invocations "Lord, have mercy" and "Christ, have mercy", after which each divine person is invoked: Heavenly Father, Son, Redeemer of the world, Holy Spirit, and Holy Trinity, one God.

There follows a long series of invocations in which God's mercy is praised under many aspects. To each, the response is: **"I trust in you"**. Divine mercy in the litany is, among other things:

- "the unfathomable mystery of the Most Holy Trinity" and "the expression of his greatest power",
- that which was revealed in the creation of heavenly spirits and which "called humans from nothingness into life",
- that which encompasses the entire world and bestows immortal life,
- that which shields from deserved punishments and liberates from the misery of sin,
- that which pours out from the wounds of Christ and flows from the Sacred Heart,
- that which gave humans the Blessed Virgin for the mother of mercy,
- that which is visible in the establishment of the Church that encompasses the entire world and in the administration of the holy sacraments,
- unlimited in the sacrament of baptism and penance and immense in the sacrament of the altar and priesthood,
- that which called humans to the holy faith,
- present in the conversion of sinners, that which sanctifies the righteous and perfects the holy,
- a spring for the sick and suffering, the consolation of those "of a broken heart" and the hope of those who despair,
- the "peace of the dying", protection from the fire of hell, and relief of suffering for the souls in purgatory,
- the delight and immense joy of all saints and an "inexhaustible source of miracles".

Particularly emphasized is the invocation to mercy "in the conversion of sinners", which directly echoes the gospel of the day about the joy of heaven over one repentant sinner.

sections.subtitle: Da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo: završna molitva vječnom Bogu
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar izgovara završnu molitvu litanija vječnom Bogu
sections.content:
Litanije završavaju psalmodijskim retkom: **„Bog je milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srđbu i pun dobrote. Zato ću dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu.“**

Vladimir Grebenar zatim moli završnu molitvu vječnom Bogu, „čije je milosrđe neistraživo i čije je blago smilovanja neiscrpivo“. Moli da Bog milosno pogleda na vjernike i umnoži u njima svoje milosrđe. Svrha te molbe izrečena je jasno: **„da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo i ne budemo obeshrabreni“**, nego da se s velikim pouzdanjem predaju Božjoj svetoj volji, „koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje“.

Molitva se zaključuje po Gospodinu Isusu Kristu, kojeg se naziva **„kraljem milosrđa“** i koji s Ocem i Duhom Svetim iskazuje milosrđe u sve vijeke vjekova. Time završava blok posvećen Božanskom milosrđu.
sections.subtitle_en: That in difficult moments we may not despair: concluding prayer to the eternal God
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar recites the concluding prayer of the litany to the eternal God
sections.content_en:
The litany concludes with a psalmodic verse: **"God is merciful and full of compassion, slow to anger and abounding in kindness. Therefore I will praise the mercy of God forever."**

Vladimir Grebenar then prays the concluding prayer to the eternal God, "whose mercy is fathomless and whose treasury of compassion is inexhaustible." He prays that God look mercifully upon the faithful and increase his mercy in them. The purpose of this petition is stated clearly: **"that in difficult moments we may not despair and not be discouraged"**, but that with great confidence they surrender to God's holy will, "which is love and mercy itself."

The prayer is concluded through the Lord Jesus Christ, who is called the **"king of mercy"** and who with the Father and the Holy Spirit shows mercy for ages of ages. With this, the block dedicated to Divine Mercy concludes.

sections.subtitle: Otajstva svjetla: od Jordana do svadbe u Kani
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje prvo otajstvo svjetla, Isusovo krštenje na rijeci Jordanu
sections.content:
Drugi veliki dio molitvenog susreta je **krunica otajstava svjetla**. Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje **prvo otajstvo**: Isus, koji je **na rijeci Jordanu kršten bio**. Svaka desetica ima isti, ustaljeni red:

- jedan **Oče naš**,
- deset **Zdravo Marijo**,
- **Slava Ocu**,
- molitva **„O moj Isuse“**.

U molitvi „O moj Isuse“ moli se za oproštenje grijeha, očuvanje od paklenoga ognja i da Isus u raj dovede sve duše, „a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe“. Ona tako i u krunici zadržava temu milosrđa koja prožima cijelu epizodu.

U **drugom otajstvu** razmatra se Isus, koji je **na svadbi u Kani objavio svoju slavu**. Ponovno slijede Oče naš, deset Zdravo Marija, Slava Ocu i zaziv „O moj Isuse“. Mirni i ujednačeni ritam ponavljanja omogućuje onima koji mole uz prijenos da se sabrano udube u svako otajstvo.
sections.subtitle_en: Luminous Mysteries: from the Jordan to the wedding at Cana
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces the first luminous mystery, Jesus' baptism in the Jordan River
sections.content_en:
The second major part of the prayer meeting is the **Rosary of the Luminous Mysteries**. Vladimir Grebenar announces the **first mystery**: Jesus, who **was baptized in the Jordan River**. Each decade follows the same, established order:

- one **Our Father**,
- ten **Hail Marys**,
- **Glory Be to the Father**,
- the prayer **"O my Jesus"**.

In the prayer "O my Jesus", prayer is made for the forgiveness of sins, preservation from the fire of hell, and that Jesus lead all souls to heaven, "especially those who are in most need of your mercy". It thus also in the Rosary retains the theme of mercy that permeates the entire episode.

In the **second mystery**, contemplation is made on Jesus, who **at the wedding at Cana manifested his glory**. Again follow the Our Father, ten Hail Marys, the Glory Be, and the invocation "O my Jesus". The calm and steady rhythm of repetition enables those praying along with the broadcast to immerse themselves in each mystery with recollection.

sections.subtitle: „Obratite se, kraljevstvo Božje je blizu“ i svjetlo s gore Tabor
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje treće otajstvo, navještaj kraljevstva Božjeg i poziv na obraćenje
sections.content:
**Treće otajstvo svjetla**, kako ga najavljuje Vladimir Grebenar, posvećeno je Isusu koji je navijestio: **„Obratite se, kraljevstvo Božje je blizu.“** Poziv na obraćenje u ovom otajstvu tematski se izravno nadovezuje na evanđelje dana kojim je epizoda otvorena, onim o radosti neba zbog jednog obraćenog grešnika. Krunica tako nastavlja nit koja povezuje sve dijelove molitve.

Zatim slijedi **četvrto otajstvo**: Isus, koji se **na gori Taboru preobrazio**. U oba otajstva voditelj se drži ustaljenog reda. Moli Oče naš, deset Zdravo Marija i Slava Ocu, a svaku deseticu zaključuje molbom „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe“, uz molitvu za duše kojima je Božje milosrđe najpotrebnije.
sections.subtitle_en: "Repent, the kingdom of God is at hand" and the light from Mount Tabor
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar announces the third mystery, the proclamation of the kingdom of God and the call to conversion
sections.content_en:
**The third mystery of light**, as announced by Vladimir Grebenar, is dedicated to Jesus who proclaimed: **"Repent, the kingdom of God is at hand."** The call to conversion in this mystery thematically connects directly to the gospel of the day with which the episode opened, the one about the joy of heaven over one repentant sinner. The Rosary thus continues the thread that connects all parts of the prayer.

Next follows the **fourth mystery**: Jesus, who **was transfigured on Mount Tabor**. In both mysteries, the host keeps to the established order. He prays the Our Father, ten Hail Marys, and Glory Be to the Father, and concludes each decade with the petition "O my Jesus, forgive us our sins", along with a prayer for the souls in most need of God's mercy.

sections.subtitle: Euharistija na Posljednjoj večeri i „Zdravo Kraljice“ kao završni pozdrav Majci milosrđa
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj zaključuje krunicu molitvom „Zdravo Kraljice“
sections.content:
Krunicu zaokružuje **peto otajstvo svjetla**: Isus, koji je **na Posljednjoj večeri ustanovio svetu euharistiju**. I ova desetica moli se istim redom kao i prethodne, a završava zazivom za milosrđe prema dušama kojima je ono najpotrebnije.

Za kraj molitvenog bloka Vladimir Grebenar izabire molitvu **„Zdravo Kraljice“**, u kojoj se Marija pozdravlja kao „majka milosrđa, život, slast i ufanje naše“. Vjernici se u njoj prepoznaju kao „prognani sinovi Evini“ koji joj vapiju i uzdišu, „tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini“. Molitva traži da Marija, kao zagovornica, svrne svoje „milostive oči“ na njih te da im nakon ovoga progona pokaže Isusa, blagoslovljeni plod svoje utrobe.

Završnim usklikom **„O blaga, o mila, o slatka Djevice Marijo“** završava zajednička molitva koja je počela molitvom oslobođenja, a vodila je kroz posvete, krunicu i litanije Božanskom milosrđu te otajstva svjetla. Cijeli molitveni dio okupljen je oko jedne poruke: milosrđa kojim Bog traži i prihvaća svakog grešnika.
sections.subtitle_en: The Eucharist at the Last Supper and "Hail Holy Queen" as the final greeting to the Mother of Mercy
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host concludes the Rosary with the prayer "Hail Holy Queen"
sections.content_en:
The Rosary is rounded off by the **fifth mystery of light**: Jesus, who **instituted the Holy Eucharist at the Last Supper**. This decade is also prayed in the same order as the previous ones, and ends with an invocation for mercy toward the souls who are most in need of it.

For the conclusion of the prayer block, Vladimir Grebenar chooses the prayer **"Hail Holy Queen"**, in which Mary is greeted as "mother of mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope." The faithful recognize themselves in it as "poor banished children of Eve" who cry and sigh to her, "mourning and weeping in this valley of tears." The prayer asks that Mary, as an advocate, turn her "eyes of mercy" toward them and that after this exile she show them Jesus, the blessed fruit of her womb.

With the final exclamation **"O clement, o loving, o sweet Virgin Mary"**, the common prayer ends, which began with the prayer of deliverance, and led through consecrations, the chaplet and litany of Divine Mercy, and the mysteries of light. The entire prayer part is gathered around one message: the mercy with which God seeks and accepts every sinner.

iterations.theme_en: Common prayer: prayer of deliverance, consecration, the Chaplet and Litany of Divine Mercy, and the Rosary of the Luminous Mysteries

iterations.theme: Tumačenje Poslanice Filipljanima i evanđelja o izgubljenoj ovci (Isus na prvom mjestu, radost zbog obraćenja grešnika) te obavijesti domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora

sections.subtitle: „Mi smo obrezanje“: Pavlov odgovor na dičenje tijelom, nacijom i zakonom
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar započinje tumačenje Pavlovih riječi iz Poslanice Filipljanima
sections.content:
Nakon molitve krunice i Zdravo Kraljice, voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** prelazi na tumačenje svete riječi iz **Poslanice Filipljanima**. Čita poznati odlomak u kojem sveti Pavao piše: „Braćo, mi smo obrezanje. Mi koji u Duhu Božjemu obavljamo bogoslužje i dičimo se Kristom Isusom, a ne pouzdajemo se u tijelo.“ Apostol zatim nabraja razloge zbog kojih bi se, kako sam kaže, mogao pouzdati u tijelo i više od drugih:

- obrezan osmoga dana,
- od roda Izraelova, plemena Benjaminova,
- Hebrej od Hebreja,
- po zakonu farizej,
- po revnosti progonitelj Crkve,
- po pravednosti zakonskoj besprijekoran.

Pavao ipak zaključuje: „Što mi god bijaše dobitak, to poradi Krista smatram gubitkom. Što više, čak sve gubitkom smatram zbog onoga najizvrsnijeg, zbog spoznanja Isusa Krista, Gospodina mojega.“

Grebenar se pita zašto apostol uopće spominje obrezanje. Objašnjava da su se Židovi hvalili time što su poseban narod. Vidljiv znak koji ih je na tijelu razlikovao od drugih naroda bilo je obrezanje muškaraca. Pritom ističe da nisu smatrali velikim sam čin obrezanja, nego **Mojsijev zakon** i način života koji iz njega proizlazi. Znak pripadnosti tom narodu nosili su na tijelu.

Prema voditelju, Židovi su se dičili nacijom: vjerovali su da su Božji narod, da nose znak Božje pripadnosti i da je svaki pojedinac član naroda koji je utemeljio sam Bog. Pavao tome suprotstavlja novu stvarnost: „obrezanje“ su sada oni koji žive u Duhu Božjem i diče se Isusom Kristom.

Grebenar to prenosi u današnje okolnosti. Hvaljenje u tijelu, kaže, bilo bi kad bi se netko dičio time što je Hrvat, katolik, što je završio visoku školu, ima uspješan posao ili karijeru. Sveti Pavao to naziva dičenjem tijelom. Kad netko misli da se može hvaliti na takav način, apostol odgovara da on može još više, pa nabraja svoja postignuća. Bio je besprijekoran farizej, vrlo učen čovjek koji je dosljedno živio zakon. Voditelj zaključuje da je upravo sve to bilo **zapreka da primi Isusa**.
sections.subtitle_en: "We are the circumcision": Paul's response to boasting in the flesh, nation, and law
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar begins the interpretation of Paul's words from the Epistle to the Philippians
sections.content_en:
After the prayer of the Rosary and Hail Holy Queen, host **Vladimir Grebenar** transitions to the interpretation of the holy word from the **Epistle to the Philippians**. He reads the well-known passage in which Saint Paul writes: "Brethren, we are the circumcision. We who worship in the Spirit of God and glory in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh." The apostle then enumerates the reasons why, as he says himself, he could have confidence in the flesh even more than others:

- circumcised on the eighth day,
- of the race of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin,
- a Hebrew of Hebrews,
- as to the law, a Pharisee,
- as to zeal, a persecutor of the Church,
- as to righteousness under the law, blameless.

Yet Paul concludes: "Whatever was gain to me, that I counted loss for the sake of Christ. More than that, I count everything as loss because of the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus, my Lord."

Grebenar wonders why the apostle mentions circumcision at all. He explains that the Jews boasted of being a special people. The visible sign that distinguished them in the flesh from other nations was the circumcision of men. At the same time, he emphasizes that they did not consider great the mere act of circumcision, but the **Law of Moses** and the way of life arising from it. The sign of belonging to that nation they bore on their bodies.

According to the host, the Jews boasted in their nation: they believed that they were God's people, that they bore the sign of belonging to God, and that each individual was a member of a nation founded by God himself. Paul contrasts this with a new reality: the "circumcision" are now those who live in the Spirit of God and boast in Jesus Christ.

Grebenar transfers this into today's circumstances. Boasting in the flesh, he says, would be if someone boasted of being a Croat, a Catholic, having graduated from higher education, having a successful job or career. Saint Paul calls this boasting in the flesh. When someone thinks they can boast in such a manner, the apostle replies that he can do so even more, and then enumerates his achievements. He was a blameless Pharisee, a very learned man who lived the law consistently. The host concludes that all of this was precisely the **obstacle to receiving Jesus**.

sections.subtitle: Kad zasluge priječe milost: poziv da se ide na zadnje mjesto
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj upozorava da i dostignuća unutar Crkve mogu biti zapreka Božjoj milosti
sections.content:
Grebenar ističe da se Pavao, kad je shvatio da se pouzdavao u tijelo, zapravo pouzdavao u **svoja svjetovna dostignuća**. Dodaje važnu napomenu: takva dostignuća ne postoje samo u svijetu, nego i u Crkvi i u vjeri.

Kao primjer navodi osobu koja sebe vidi prvenstveno kao voditelja molitvene zajednice. Kada se netko tako doživljava, upozorava Grebenar, to **priječi djelovanje Božje milosti**.

Nudi i protulijek: „Najbolje je kad ništa ne očekuješ, pa te Bog postavi tamo gdje on želi.“ Savjetuje da se uvijek ide na zadnje mjesto i da se čovjek ne gura naprijed. Onaj tko sjedne na posljednje mjesto, kaže, biva od Boga postavljen na bolje.

Zato, prema njegovu tumačenju, sveti Pavao uči da se ne treba dičiti tijelom ni svjetovnim dostignućima. Pod tim voditelj nabraja fakultetske diplome, dobre automobile, stanove, kuće i karijere.
sections.subtitle_en: When merits hinder grace: a call to go to the lowest place
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host warns that achievements within the Church can also be an obstacle to God's grace
sections.content_en:
Grebenar emphasizes that Paul, when he realized he was putting confidence in the flesh, was actually relying on **his worldly achievements**. He adds an important observation: such achievements exist not only in the world, but also in the Church and in faith.

As an example, he mentions a person who views himself primarily as a leader of a prayer group. When someone perceives themselves that way, Grebenar warns, it **hinders the work of God's grace**.

He also offers an antidote: "It is best when you expect nothing, so God puts you where he wants." He advises always going to the lowest place and not pushing oneself forward. The one who sits in the lowest place, he says, is placed by God into a better one.

Therefore, according to his interpretation, Saint Paul teaches not to boast in the flesh or in worldly achievements. Under that, the host lists university degrees, good cars, apartments, houses, and careers.

sections.subtitle: Isus na prvom mjestu: kad znanje postaje Božje oružje
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar govori o svom profesionalnom putu i početku navještanja evanđelja
sections.content:
Umjesto svjetovnih postignuća, naglašava Grebenar, dičiti se treba **Isusom Kristom**. Kad je Krist na prvom mjestu i kad ga vjernici navješćuju, sve što su stekli „u tijelu“ podredi se Bogu i on to iskoristi.

Kao primjer opet uzima Pavla. Apostol nije izgubio znanje o Mojsijevu zakonu i Starom zavjetu. Kad se krstio i primio Duha Svetoga, cijelo to znanje počeo je koristiti za evangelizaciju. „Tek tada je naučio kako treba znati“, ističe voditelj. Pavao se nije odrekao znanja koje je stjecao desetljećima. Upravo je tada, kad je Isusa stavio na prvo mjesto, to znanje postalo **Božje oružje** kojim je obratio mnoge ljude.

Grebenar zatim dijeli osobno iskustvo, o kojem je, kako kaže, govorio i dan ranije na jednom od skupova koje svakodnevno održava. U svojoj je struci dugo rastao osobno i profesionalno. Došao je do točke na kojoj je za jednu osobu imao „puno škole, puno ekspertize“. Tek tada je počeo navještati evanđelje. Prema njegovim riječima, Gospodin ga je tada upotrijebio, pa se sada i znanje iz njegove struke koristi za obraćenje drugih i za Božje pothvate. Kao jedan takav pothvat navodi **domoljubnu inicijativu Ora et Labora**.

Poruku sažima ovako: ono što se nauči vlastitim trudom, kroz školovanje i rad, Bog na najbolji način iskoristi kad se Isusa stavi na prvo mjesto. Za to je, upozorava, potrebna **strpljivost s Bogom**, jer Bog radi na duge staze, a ne na kratke.
sections.subtitle_en: Jesus in first place: when knowledge becomes God's weapon
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar speaks about his professional journey and the beginning of proclaiming the gospel
sections.content_en:
Instead of worldly achievements, Grebenar emphasizes, one should boast in **Jesus Christ**. When Christ is in first place and when the faithful proclaim him, everything they acquired "in the flesh" is subordinated to God and he utilizes it.

As an example, he again takes Paul. The apostle did not lose his knowledge of the Law of Moses and the Old Testament. When he was baptized and received the Holy Spirit, he began to use all that knowledge for evangelization. "Only then did he learn how one ought to know," the host emphasizes. Paul did not renounce the knowledge he had acquired over decades. It was precisely then, when he put Jesus in first place, that this knowledge became **God's weapon** by which he converted many people.

Grebenar then shares personal experience, about which, as he says, he spoke the day before at one of the gatherings he holds daily. In his profession, he grew personally and professionally for a long time. He reached a point where, for one person, he had "a lot of schooling, a lot of expertise." Only then did he begin to proclaim the gospel. According to his words, the Lord used him then, and now the knowledge from his profession is also used for the conversion of others and for God's endeavors. As one such endeavor, he cites the **patriotic initiative Ora et Labora**.

He summarizes the message like this: what is learned through one's own effort, through schooling and work, God uses in the best way when Jesus is put in first place. For that, he warns, **patience with God** is necessary, because God works for the long haul, not the short.

sections.subtitle: Psalam radosti i prispodobe o izgubljenoj ovci i drahmi
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj čita evanđelje o pastiru koji ostavlja 99 ovaca kako bi pronašao izgubljenu
sections.content:
Nakon tumačenja poslanice Grebenar čita psalam s pripjevom **„Neka se raduje srce onih što traže Gospodina“**. Psalam poziva na pjesmu i sviranje Gospodinu, pripovijedanje njegovih čudesa i dičenje njegovim svetim imenom. Poziva i da se svagda traži Gospodina, njegova snaga i lice. Spominje Abrahamov rod i sinove Jakovljeve kao Gospodnje izabranike te završava riječima: „On je Gospodin Bog naš. Po svoj su zemlji njegovi sudovi.“

Slijedi evanđelje. Oko Isusa okupljaju se carinici i grešnici kako bi ga slušali, dok farizeji i pismoznanci mrmljaju: „Ovaj prima grešnike i blaguje s njima.“ Isus im odgovara dvjema prispodobama.

U prvoj čovjek ima sto ovaca i izgubi jednu. Ostavlja devedeset i devet u pustinji i traži izgubljenu dok je ne nađe. Kad je pronađe, radostan je stavlja na ramena, saziva prijatelje i susjede i kaže: „Radujte se sa mnom, nađoh ovcu svoju izgubljenu.“ Isus zaključuje da će na nebu biti **veća radost zbog jednog obraćena grešnika** nego zbog devedeset i devet pravednika kojima ne treba obraćenja.

Druga prispodoba govori o ženi koja ima deset drahmi i izgubi jednu. Zapali svjetiljku, pomete kuću i brižno je traži dok je ne nađe. Kad je nađe, poziva prijateljice i susjede da se raduju s njom. „Tako, kažem vam, biva radost pred anđelima Božjim zbog jednog obraćena grešnika.“
sections.subtitle_en: Psalm of joy and parables of the lost sheep and the drachma
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host reads the gospel about the shepherd who leaves 99 sheep to find the lost one
sections.content_en:
After the interpretation of the epistle, Grebenar reads a psalm with the response **"Let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice"**. The psalm calls for singing and making music to the Lord, recounting his wondrous deeds, and glorying in his holy name. It also calls to seek the Lord always, his strength and his face. It mentions the offspring of Abraham and the sons of Jacob as the Lord's chosen ones, and concludes with the words: "He is the Lord our God. In all the earth are his judgments."

The gospel follows. Tax collectors and sinners gather around Jesus to hear him, while Pharisees and scribes murmur: "This man welcomes sinners and eats with them." Jesus answers them with two parables.

In the first, a man has a hundred sheep and loses one. He leaves the ninety-nine in the desert and searches for the lost one until he finds it. When he finds it, he joyfully sets it on his shoulders, gathers his friends and neighbors, and says: "Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep." Jesus concludes that there will be **greater joy in heaven over one repentant sinner** than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance.

The second parable speaks of a woman who has ten drachmas and loses one. She lights a lamp, sweeps the house, and diligently searches until she finds it. When she finds it, she invites female friends and neighbors to rejoice with her. "Just so, I tell you, there is joy before the angels of God over one repentant sinner."

sections.subtitle: Isusova misija: obraćenje grešnika, silazak nad pakao i čistilište
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj objašnjava silazak Krista u podzemlje i oslobođenje duša pravednika
sections.content:
Tumačeći evanđelje, Grebenar ističe da Isus njime želi naglasiti da je **obraćenje grešnika** misija zbog koje je došao na zemlju. Vjernici bi, kaže, to trebali posvijestiti.

Ključni razlog Isusova dolaska, prema voditelju, jest da se ljudi obrate, da vjeruju u jedinorođenoga Sina Božjega i da se svijet spasi. Svrha nije osuda grešnika i njihovo bacanje u pakao, nego spasenje.

Objašnjava i da prije Isusa pravednici nisu mogli uzaći na nebo. Nakon smrti na križu Krist je sašao u podzemlje i oslobodio duše pravednika da odu u raj. Grebenar predviđa pitanje kako su se duše pravednika uopće našle u podzemlju i odgovara: grijeha su imali svi, pa i pravednici. „Nema nikoga tko nije imao grijeha. Nema danas nikoga tko je bez grijeha.“

Budući da u nebo ne može ući ništa nečisto, pojašnjava voditelj, i mali grijesi koji su „zaprljali naše haljine“ razlog su zbog kojeg čovjek ne može odmah ući u raj, nego mora ostati u **čistilištu**.

Isusovu misiju zatim povezuje s njegovim riječima: „Nisam došao zvati pravednike, nego grešnike. Ne treba zdravima liječnik, nego bolesnima.“ Zaključuje da je **Isus liječnik**, a prispodoba o pastiru koji se raduje pronađenoj ovci više nego devedeset i devet onih u toru izražava upravo tu poruku.
sections.subtitle_en: Jesus' mission: conversion of sinners, descent into hell, and purgatory
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host explains the descent of Christ into the underworld and the liberation of the souls of the righteous
sections.content_en:
Interpreting the gospel, Grebenar emphasizes that Jesus through it wants to stress that the **conversion of sinners** is the mission for which he came to earth. The faithful, he says, should become conscious of this.

The key reason for Jesus' coming, according to the host, is that people convert, believe in the only-begotten Son of God, and that the world be saved. The purpose is not condemnation of sinners and casting them into hell, but salvation.

He also explains that before Jesus, the righteous could not ascend to heaven. After his death on the cross, Christ descended into the underworld and liberated the souls of the righteous so they could go to heaven. Grebenar anticipates the question of how the souls of the righteous found themselves in the underworld in the first place and answers: everyone had sins, even the righteous. "There is no one who did not have sin. Today there is no one who is without sin."

Since nothing unclean can enter heaven, the host clarifies, even small sins that "soiled our garments" are the reason why a person cannot immediately enter heaven, but must remain in **purgatory**.

He then connects Jesus' mission with his words: "I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners. Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick." He concludes that **Jesus is a physician**, and the parable of the shepherd who rejoices over the found sheep more than the ninety-nine in the fold expresses precisely that message.

sections.subtitle: Test vjere: raduješ li se kad drugi obrate grešnika?
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar postavlja gledateljima pitanje o radosti zbog tuđeg uspjeha u evangelizaciji
sections.content:
Iz prispodobe o ženi koja pronalazi drahmu i poziva prijateljice da se raduju s njom Grebenar izvodi pitanje koje je, priznaje, mnogo puta postavio i sebi: **„Radujem li se ja obraćenju grešnika preko drugih ljudi?“**

Konkretizira ga: kad čuje da je neki svećenik ili laik nekoga obratio i priveo Kristu, raduje li se tome iskreno? Anđeli se tome raduju, raduju se sveti i raduje se Presveto Trojstvo. Ako se netko tome ne raduje, kaže voditelj, to otkriva kakva je on osoba: da nije dobra, nego zla osoba.

Razlika je prema njemu jasna. Zli ljudi ne raduju se obraćenju grešnika, a dobri se raduju. Isus je došao obratiti grešnike, pa radost zbog obraćenja zapravo je radost zbog samoga Isusa. „Isus je naša radost“, naglašava.

Vjernicima zato predlaže da si postave taj **test**. To je, kaže, jedan od kriterija po kojem svatko može ocijeniti kakva je njegova vjera.
sections.subtitle_en: Test of faith: do you rejoice when others convert a sinner?
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar poses a question to viewers about rejoicing over another's success in evangelization
sections.content_en:
From the parable of the woman who finds the drachma and calls her friends to rejoice with her, Grebenar draws a question that, he admits, he has asked himself many times: **"Do I rejoice over the conversion of a sinner through other people?"**

He makes it concrete: when he hears that some priest or layperson converted someone and brought them to Christ, does he honestly rejoice over that? The angels rejoice over it, the saints rejoice, and the Most Holy Trinity rejoices. If someone does not rejoice over that, the host says, it reveals what kind of person he is: that he is not a good person, but an evil person.

The difference according to him is clear. Evil people do not rejoice over the conversion of sinners, and good people do rejoice. Jesus came to convert sinners, so joy over conversion is actually joy over Jesus himself. "Jesus is our joy," he emphasizes.

He therefore suggests to the faithful to give themselves that **test**. That is, he says, one of the criteria by which everyone can assess what kind of faith they have.

sections.subtitle: Kraće razmatranje zbog turneje: Pazin, Umag, Valpovo, Nova Gradiška, Bjelovar i Samobor
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje raspored promocija knjige i predstavljanja domoljubne inicijative
sections.content:
Grebenar ovdje završava tumačenje i moli gledatelje za malo „kredita“. Objašnjava da zbog vrlo intenzivnog tempa promocija i predstavljanja inicijative trenutačno ne može tumačiti duže. Ipak ne želi uskratiti molitvu i tumačenje riječi, pa je razmatranje kraće. Vjeruje da je mnogima i to dovoljno jer nastoji naglasiti bitne stvari. Vjernike koji prate emisiju potiče da sami više mole, razmatraju i „druže se s Isusom“.

Slijedi najava promocija knjige i predstavljanja **domoljubne inicijative**:

- **Pazin**, petak, 6. studenoga, hotel Lovac, Šime Kurelića 4. Program počinje u 19 sati krunicom i uvodnom riječi, a samo predstavljanje knjige predviđeno je oko 20 sati.
- **Umag**, subota, 7. studenoga, hotel Garden Istra, Katoro.
- **Valpovo**, utorak, 10. studenoga, Vila Valpovo, Bana Josipa Jelačića 1.
- **Nova Gradiška**, srijeda, 11. studenoga, Centar kompetencija, Industrijska ulica 23/1.
- **Bjelovar**, četvrtak, 12. studenoga, Tehnološki park Bjelovar, Trg hrvatskih branitelja 14.
- **Samobor**, petak, 13. studenoga, hotel Lavica, Ferde Livadića 7.

Voditelj posebno moli gledatelje iz Istre, s područja Umaga i Pazina i okolice, da banner s Facebook stranice Ora et Labora podijele na svojim društvenim mrežama i pozovu one kojima bi to moglo koristiti. Poziva da svatko tko sluša, posti i moli pozove i dovede barem jednu osobu. Ako se ta osoba obrati, kaže, „tebi se računa u pravednost“. Najavljuje i da će sljedećeg dana objaviti nastavak rasporeda.
sections.subtitle_en: Shorter reflection due to tour: Pazin, Umag, Valpovo, Nova Gradiška, Bjelovar, and Samobor
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces the schedule of book promotions and presentations of the patriotic initiative
sections.content_en:
Here Grebenar ends the interpretation and asks viewers for a little "credit". He explains that due to the very intense pace of promotions and presentations of the initiative, he cannot currently provide longer interpretations. Nevertheless, he does not want to withhold prayer and interpretation of the word, so the reflection is shorter. He believes that for many this is also sufficient because he strives to emphasize the essential things. He encourages the faithful following the show to pray more themselves, meditate, and "hang out with Jesus".

There follows the announcement of book promotions and presentations of the **patriotic initiative**:

- **Pazin**, Friday, November 6, hotel Lovac, Šime Kurelića 4. The program begins at 7:00 PM with the Rosary and opening remarks, and the book presentation itself is planned around 8:00 PM.
- **Umag**, Saturday, November 7, hotel Garden Istra, Katoro.
- **Valpovo**, Tuesday, November 10, Vila Valpovo, Bana Josipa Jelačića 1.
- **Nova Gradiška**, Wednesday, November 11, Centar kompetencija, Industrijska ulica 23/1.
- **Bjelovar**, Thursday, November 12, Tehnološki park Bjelovar, Trg hrvatskih branitelja 14.
- **Samobor**, Friday, November 13, hotel Lavica, Ferde Livadića 7.

The host specifically asks viewers from Istria, from the area of Umag and Pazin and surroundings, to share the banner from the Ora et Labora Facebook page on their social networks and invite those who could benefit from it. He invites everyone who listens, fasts, and prays to invite and bring at least one person. If that person converts, he says, "it is credited to you as righteousness". He also announces that he will publish the rest of the schedule the following day.

sections.subtitle: Članstvo, donacije i portal Ora et Labora: od geopolitike do sporta
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar predstavlja portal Ora et Labora i poziva na čitanje
sections.content:
Grebenar zatim poziva gledatelje da postanu **članovi domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora** tako što će ispuniti obrazac na mrežnoj stranici inicijative. Navodi i da su na ekranu brojevi mobitela suradnika iz Hrvatske i Bosne i Hercegovine, koje zainteresirani mogu nazvati za dodatne informacije.

Zahvaljuje svima koji podržavaju i doniraju inicijativu. Ističe da je to vrlo važno jer se pokreću, kako kaže, veliki i važni projekti za hrvatski narod u Hrvatskoj, u Bosni i Hercegovini i svugdje drugdje.

Posebno predstavlja **portal Ora et Labora**, koji je, prema njegovim riječima, „sve bolji i bolji“. Priznaje da bi mogao djelovati pristrano jer je i sam dio organizacije. Ipak tvrdi da bi i kao promatrator sa strane smatrao da na portalu ima što pročitati i naučiti. Kaže da je portal „digao“ razinu i da dnevno donosi mnogo objava i kvalitetnih tekstova.

Naglašava da to **nije vjerski portal** u užem smislu. Duhovnosti ima dosta i pišu i svećenici, ali cilj je donijeti istinu iz svih područja ljudskog života:

- politike i geopolitike,
- domaće politike,
- sporta,
- kulture i umjetnosti,
- povijesti.

Poziv na donacije ponavlja i ističe da su dobrodošli i mali iznosi od 5 ili 10 eura, uplaćeni kad se tko sjeti. Podsjeća vjernike na ono što im je Gospodin dao kroz zajedničke molitve i postove i zaključuje: „Dižemo nešto veliko na slavu Božju.“
sections.subtitle_en: Membership, donations, and the Ora et Labora portal: from geopolitics to sports
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar presents the Ora et Labora portal and invites reading
sections.content_en:
Grebenar then invites viewers to become **members of the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora** by filling out the form on the initiative's website. He also states that the mobile phone numbers of associates from Croatia and Bosnia and Herzegovina are on the screen, whom interested parties can call for additional information.

He thanks everyone who supports and donates to the initiative. He emphasizes that this is very important because large and important projects, as he says, are being launched for the Croatian people in Croatia, in Bosnia and Herzegovina, and everywhere else.

He especially presents the **portal Ora et Labora**, which is, according to his words, "better and better". He admits that he might seem biased because he is also part of the organization. Yet he claims that even as an outside observer he would consider that there is something to read and learn on the portal. He says that the portal has "raised" its level and that it daily brings many posts and quality texts.

He stresses that this is **not a religious portal** in the narrow sense. There is plenty of spirituality and priests write too, but the goal is to bring the truth from all areas of human life:

- politics and geopolitics,
- domestic politics,
- sports,
- culture and art,
- history.

He repeats the call for donations and emphasizes that even small amounts of 5 or 10 euros are welcome, paid whenever one remembers. He reminds the faithful of what the Lord gave them through common prayers and fasts and concludes: "We are raising something great to the glory of God."

sections.subtitle: Ivankino svjedočanstvo: narkolepsija, post i poruka da se ne pouzdaje u čovjeka
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj čita Ivankino svjedočanstvo o nestanku simptoma narkolepsije i katapleksije
sections.content:
U dijelu posvećenom ozdravljenjima Grebenar čita svjedočanstvo gledateljice **Ivanke**. Ona piše da od posta i molitve s Ora et Labora nema simptoma **narkolepsije i katapleksije**.

Ivanka navodi da je u dogovoru s neurologinjom iz Zagreba odavno prestala uzimati lijekove. Ipak je i dalje znala osjećati umor nakon jela i blage simptome katapleksije. Od bolesti pati od sedmog razreda osnovne škole, a sada ima 33 godine. Oboljelima od narkolepsije i katapleksije preporučuje da pročitaju odlomak o padavičaru iz **Evanđelja po Marku, 9. poglavlje, retci 14 do 29**, s Isusovim riječima: „Ovaj se rod ničim drugim ne može izagnati osim molitvom i postom.“

Dodaje da tijekom posta može normalno funkcionirati, ali uvijek u molitvi dobro osluškuje je li pozvana na neki post ili nije. Svjedočanstvo završava rečenicom: „Ne častim i ne slavim Vladimira, nego Isusa Krista, Oca i Duha Svetoga.“ Vladimira, piše, smatra običnim čovjekom koji životom želi vršiti volju Očevu i koji vjernike često potiče na molitvu, pomoć i poslušnost Crkvi.

Grebenar je oduševljen. „Bravo. Kako si ovo lijepo napisala“, kaže, posebno hvaleći završni dio. Na tome gradi poruku: **nikad se ne treba pouzdavati u čovjeka**. Čovjek može iznevjeriti i razočarati, a Isus nikada. Otvoreno priznaje da i on sam može razočarati ljude. Kao primjer navodi Judu, koji je tri i pol godine bio s Isusom, a zatim ga izdao.

Zaključak je u skladu s naslovom epizode. Ljudi mogu razočarati jedni druge, ali Isus i Blažena Djevica Marija nikada. Zato **Isus mora biti na prvom mjestu, i onda će sve doći na svoje mjesto**.
sections.subtitle_en: Ivanka's testimony: narcolepsy, fasting, and the message not to trust in man
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host reads Ivanka's testimony about the disappearance of symptoms of narcolepsy and cataplexy
sections.content_en:
In the part dedicated to healings, Grebenar reads the testimony of viewer **Ivanka**. She writes that through fasting and prayer with Ora et Labora she has no symptoms of **narcolepsy and cataplexy**.

Ivanka states that in agreement with a female neurologist from Zagreb she stopped taking medications a long time ago. Nevertheless, she could still feel fatigue after meals and mild symptoms of cataplexy. She has suffered from the illness since the seventh grade of elementary school, and now she is 33 years old. To those suffering from narcolepsy and cataplexy, she recommends reading the passage about the epileptic boy from the **Gospel of Mark, chapter 9, verses 14 to 29**, with Jesus' words: "This kind cannot be driven out by anything but prayer and fasting."

She adds that during fasting she can function normally, but always in prayer listens carefully whether she is called to a particular fast or not. The testimony concludes with the sentence: "I do not honor and glorify Vladimir, but Jesus Christ, the Father, and the Holy Spirit." She considers Vladimir, she writes, an ordinary man who wants by his life to do the will of the Father and who often encourages the faithful to prayer, helping others, and obedience to the Church.

Grebenar is delighted. "Bravo. How beautifully you wrote this," he says, praising especially the concluding part. On that he builds the message: **one should never trust in man**. Man can fail and disappoint, but Jesus never. He openly admits that he himself can also disappoint people. As an example, he mentions Judas, who was with Jesus for three and a half years, and then betrayed him.

The conclusion is in line with the episode's title. People can disappoint one another, but Jesus and the Blessed Virgin Mary never. That is why **Jesus must be in first place, and then everything will fall into its proper place**.

sections.subtitle: Krunica diljem Hrvatske i centar Kraljica Mira u Međugorju
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar opisuje svoj privatni projekt Međunarodnog edukacijskog centra Kraljica Mira u Međugorju
sections.content:
Pred kraj emisije Grebenar poziva na **molitvu krunice u svim hrvatskim gradovima** u subotu, za dva do tri dana. Najavljuje i da Hrvati iz dijaspore organiziraju prijevoz iz **Njemačke i Austrije** na molitvu krunice na glavnom trgu u **Zagrebu**. Kontakti su prikazani na ekranu, a voditelj ističe da se još stigne prijaviti i spremiti za put. Zatim udjeljuje blagoslov: „Neka se sveta Mati sa svojim Sinom i svetim Josipom udostoji blagoslov nam dati, u ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga.“

Na kraju govori o svom **privatnom projektu Međunarodnog edukacijskog centra Kraljica Mira**. Bit će to, kaže, svojevrsni centar za navjestitelje Božje riječi iz različitih područja, primjerice poduzetništva i medicine. Projekt je pokrenuo vlastitim sredstvima, ponajviše prihodima od knjiga i novcem koji je uštedio. Sada ga mora dovršiti.

Opisuje i lokaciju u **Međugorju**. Prostor se nalazi tri do četiri stotine metara iza pošte, od kružnog toka u smjeru Čitluka, s lijeve strane, gdje su dvije zgrade. Projekt je u prizemlju jedne od njih, ima preko 300 kvadratnih metara i praktički je pred uporabnom dozvolom.

Grebenar naglašava da od projekta ne očekuje nikakvu financijsku korist, iako je riječ o velikom trošku. Sve je kalkulacije, kaže, predao Gospodinu i ne želi o tome razmišljati. Odbacuje i optužbe kojima je bio izložen: „Nisam gradio sebi nikakve vile i rezidencije, kako su me napadali, već naprotiv centar gdje će se navještati riječ Božja.“

Potrebna su mu još dodatna financijska sredstva. Dio će, kaže, sigurno dati iz vlastite imovine, a sve koji osjete poticaj poziva da pomognu **kupnjom knjiga**. Zahvaljuje svima koji već pomažu na taj način i blagoslivlja ih.

Emisiju zatvara pozivom: „Prati svaki dan Ora et Labora. Neka je sve na veću slavu Božju.“
sections.subtitle_en: Rosary throughout Croatia and the Queen of Peace center in Međugorje
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar describes his private project of the Queen of Peace International Educational Center in Međugorje
sections.content_en:
Toward the end of the show, Grebenar calls for the **prayer of the Rosary in all Croatian cities** on Saturday, in two to three days. He also announces that Croats from the diaspora are organizing transportation from **Germany and Austria** for the prayer of the Rosary in the main square in **Zagreb**. Contacts are shown on the screen, and the host emphasizes that there is still time to sign up and get ready for the trip. Then he imparts a blessing: "May the holy Mother with her Son and Saint Joseph deign to give us a blessing, in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit."

At the end, he speaks about his **private project of the Queen of Peace International Educational Center**. It will be, he says, a kind of center for proclaimers of God's word from various fields, such as entrepreneurship and medicine. He launched the project with his own funds, mostly proceeds from books and money he had saved. Now he must complete it.

He also describes the location in **Međugorje**. The premises are located three to four hundred meters behind the post office, from the roundabout in the direction of Čitluk, on the left side, where there are two buildings. The project is on the ground floor of one of them, has over 300 square meters, and is practically before obtaining an occupancy permit.

Grebenar emphasizes that he expects no financial benefit from the project, even though it represents a great expense. All calculations, he says, he has surrendered to the Lord and does not want to think about it. He also rejects the accusations to which he was subjected: "I did not build myself any villas and residences, as they attacked me, but on the contrary a center where the word of God will be proclaimed."

He still needs additional financial resources. Part, he says, he will certainly give from his own assets, and all who feel prompted he invites to help by **purchasing books**. He thanks everyone who is already helping in this way and blesses them.

He closes the show with an invitation: "Follow Ora et Labora every day. May everything be to the greater glory of God."

iterations.theme_en: Interpretation of the Epistle to the Philippians and the gospel of the lost sheep (Jesus in first place, joy over the conversion of a sinner) and announcements of the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora
